text: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Approach, Air China 101, Request Return to Your Airport, Dense Smoke Reported in the Rear Cargo Hold. Air China 101, Roger Mayday, Turn Left Heading 090, Descend To and Maintain 1,200 m on QNH, Radar Vector ILS Approach Runway 3-6 Right. Question. Why did Air China 101 return?
